title.narrative: Support the Ministry of Education of El Salvador in the prevention of violence

description.narrative: This 4-years project is aimed at implementing one of the 4 components of a major EU funded initiative aimed at strengthening the capacities of El Salvador Ministry of Education to reduce violence in and through education. Expertise France is in charge of the coordination of the 4 components, and UNESCO and UNICEF will implement one of those components which this workplan is about. This workplan is focused on strengthening the capacities of MoE El Salvador to deliver transformative education contents and pedagogies based on global citizenship education related themes framed under target 4.7, such as citizenship education, peace education, intercultural education and arts and culture education. The other components are aimed at promoting the design and implementation at schools of living together and equality and equity institutional plans and committees and the improvement of TVET quality and access expansion.
